node.statement: Validated node 1.1.2 proves that H is absent from every registered definition and every one of the six permitted externals. Therefore H cannot be discharged in this workspace. Defining kappa=abs(c_0^cb) may repair sign and denominator positivity, but it supplies no premise making kappa independent of implicit parameters; K_1 depending on kappa is consequently not proved universal. This establishes the exact limitation of the amended node and abandons the invalid unconditional inference.
